decisions.reason: Ties the top-level import in client.js to the boot log's classic-script combo and the compile error at 1:1; explains all-or-nothing registration and that typert-registry is just the first awaited entry. Limits the ESM invalidity to classic scripts.

Bisects the patch insert rows and fully describes the ModuleLoader.load({id,factory}) wrapper, id matching the package name, React via the factory require, and inject/apply exports. However, its parse check and pre-publish gate rely on node --check, which can accept ESM; there is no real classic-script parse such as vm.Script.

Uses the apply error to explain that the parent entry owns the declaration and apply order is undefined. Shows ctx.slots.inject wrapping a deferred register call, and allows name/id/order/label while forbidding kind/scope.

Explains the combo is built once at boot, so edits and refresh do nothing. Gives a full stop, taskkill /T /F tree cleanup, restart, refresh, then a plugin-list check. Attributes EADDRINUSE to the orphaned process still holding the port.

Proposes a host-side per-bundle classic compile check with culprit attribution, plus optional quarantine. The checklist covers the loader factory, host React, inject/apply, deferred cross-entry slots, and restart with Windows tree cleanup.

caps.reason: The report advises against bare ESM, keeps slots.inject, forbids kind/scope and requires host restarts. It gives no contradictory advice.
